Messages.Author: kindred_historian
Messages.Body:
This has probably been asked before...

How does Skin Trap at Superior effect allies?

Skin Trap [SW]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Vicissitude
Play before range is determined. Opposing minion may not dodge this
round. A vampire can play only one Skin Trap each round. (S) As above,
and opposing minion cannot strike at all this round unless he or she
burns one blood immediately.

Thanks,
Justin

At superior, the ally cannot strike.

Allies can not blood to burn to gain strikes.
Some may burn life for specific disciplines or in
specific situations, but not for this situation.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <957pnq$7el$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,
gray...@my-deja.com asked about skin trap and allies burning blood:

> > At superior, the ally cannot strike.
> >
> > Allies do not have blood to burn to gain strikes.
> > Some may burn life for specific disciplines or in
> > specific situations, but not for this situation.
>

> I thought that allies "ignore all burn blood effects entirely". I'm
> sure LSJ said that somewhere. Does that not apply in this case?

Actually, Tom Wylie said it, March 26th, 1996.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulings.html

I am not an LSJ, but this would be my answer.

It does not apply in this case.

The card says "opposing minion cannot strike at all this round unless

he or she burns one blood immediately."

It doesn't say opposing vampire, it specifies minion.

Since allies can't burn blood (not having any vampire blood),
they cannot strike that round.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The Lasombra <TheLa...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> gray...@my-deja.com asked about skin trap and allies burning blood:
> > > At superior, the ally cannot strike.
> > >
> > > Allies do not have blood to burn to gain strikes.
> > > Some may burn life for specific disciplines or in
> > > specific situations, but not for this situation.
> >
> > I thought that allies "ignore all burn blood effects entirely". I'm
> > sure LSJ said that somewhere. Does that not apply in this case?
>

> It does not apply in this case.
>

> Since allies can't burn blood (not having any vampire blood),
> they cannot strike that round.

Correct. Since allies cannot burn blood, they ignore "burn blood"
effects. This doesn't allow them to behave as if they had burned
blood, however. If they have to burn blood to achieve (or avoid)
some effect, they fail to burn a blood and therefore fail to
achieve (or avoid) the effect.
